title: Return coord_join before bounded code-state registration blocks the lease
problem: coord_join currently waits for initial code-state indexing before returning the agent lease, so a large worktree can make a valid session time out or expire before the caller receives its handle.

acceptanceCriteria.condition: coord_join returns the project/session handle within a bounded client timeout without waiting for the full initial code-state scan.
The joined worktree is registered and code-state indexing completes or degrades explicitly after the join response.
Background registration failures are contained and do not create an unhandled rejection or invalidate the already-issued session handle.
Windows Node 24, Ubuntu Node 22/24, macOS Node 24, release checks, and installed-package smoke all pass.

evidencePlan.coordination: Record pre-change Intent, impact entities, stable predecessor receipt, retry lineage, and final WorkItem handoff.
evidencePlan.evaluation: Bind the initial join-latency failure and repaired retry to server-verified stable receipts.
evidencePlan.correctness: Preserve the exact join timeout, eventual health observation, targeted tests, and remote check-run conclusions.
